Year Plan
2026 Enhance efficiency of existing stores to retain customers and drive sales growth.
2027 Expand sales channels through self -investment and strategic partnerships.

•Inappropriate site selection or high competition 
may result in lower -than-expected customer 
traffic and sales.
•High-potential locations often involve higher 
costs, leading to reduced profitability and 
longer payback periods.
RISK IMPACT
•Financial Impact: Lower -than-expected sales and 
higher fixed costs, resulting in reduced profit margins, 
weaker cash flows, and longer payback periods.
•Operational Impact:  Underperforming branches and 
inefficient utilization of resources, personnel, and 
assets, potentially requiring branch downsizing or 
relocation in the future.
•Strategic Impact: Expansion not progressing as 
planned, leading to slower revenue growth and market 
share expansion, and reduced competitiveness in the 
area.
•Reputational Impact: Unsuccessful branches may 
undermine the confidence of customers, partners, and 
investors in the Company ’s expansion capabilities.
RISK MITIGATION MEASURES  
•Revenue potential analysis: Assess sales performance of nearby stores and local customer behavior to set realistic revenue assumptions.
•Local marketing strategy: Tailor marketing and promotions to fit local customer profiles and competitive conditions.
•Investment risk diversification: Partner with local operators through franchises or co -investments to reduce investment and cost risks.2026 2027 2028+2.8%+2.8%+2.8%
